references.note: Heat shock proteins (HSP70/HSP90 families) are primary cellular stress response. HSF1 is the master transcriptional regulator of heat shock genes.

curation_notes: Removed ATM, ATR, CCAR2, GSK3B, MAPK1, MAPK3, NUP62, RPA1, RPA2, RPA3, SEH1L, SIRT1, TPR, YWHAE: nucleoporins, replication protein A and DNA-damage kinases are not the heat shock response this state scores

Inversion/housekeeping sweep 2026-08-10: removed HSPA8 (HSC70 is a constitutive chaperone and one of the most abundant transcripts in every cell - in a rank-based scorer it inflates this state for all cells) and HSF1 (activated post-translationally by trimerisation/phosphorylation; HSF1 mRNA is not heat-shock-induced, so transcript level does not report stress).

references.title: EGR2 and EGR3 are negative regulators of T cell activation
references.authors: Mognol GP, González-Avalos E, Ghosh S, Spreafico R, Gudlur A, Rao A, Hogan PG
references.note: EGR2 and EGR3 promote T cell anergy by inducing negative regulators of TCR signaling

curation_notes: Review 2026-08-10, no removals: the NR4A/EGR core and the anergy-induced E3-ligase module (CBLB, RNF128/GRAIL, ITCH) are retained. FLAG for expert: NFATC2 is constitutively expressed in T cells (NFAT1 acts by dephosphorylation, not transcription) and is a weak positive marker; NR4A/EGR genes are also activation immediate-early genes, so acutely activated cells can transiently score here - read alongside the activated state.

Final pass 2026-08-10, FLAG for expert: IZUMO1R (FR4) and NRP1 rest on mouse anergy/Treg literature - the ADT file dropped FR4 as mouse-only for the same reason; human evidence for both as anergy transcripts is thin. Kept pending expert call since both are additional-tier and low-expressed in human T cells (low rank-based risk).

cell-death.description: Apoptotic and necroptotic cell death pathways. Includes both extrinsic (death receptor) and intrinsic (mitochondrial) pathways.

references.title: Regulation of apoptosis and necroptosis pathways in immune cells
references.authors: General review - user-provided list
references.note: FAS/FASLG mediate extrinsic pathway, BID links extrinsic and intrinsic pathways, caspases execute apoptosis

curation_notes: Removed AKT1, MAGED1, RPS27A, UBA52, UBB, UBC, YWHAE: ubiquitin-encoding and 14-3-3 genes are among the most highly expressed transcripts in every cell; UCell ranks genes within each cell, so these rank near the top universally and inflate the score for cells that are not dying

Inversion sweep 2026-08-10: removed BIRC2, BIRC3, XIAP, CFLAR, TRAF2 - anti-apoptotic/pro-survival genes (IAPs, cFLIP, NF-kB adaptor) induced in cells RESISTING death; scoring them rewards the directional opposite of this state. Removed MAPK8 (ubiquitous JNK signalling kinase, same class as the MAPK removals from senescence).

FLAG for expert: the remaining extrinsic-pathway machinery (CASP8, FADD, TRADD, RIPK1, TNFRSF1A) is constitutively expressed and activated post-translationally, so transcript level is weak evidence of dying cells; in scRNA-seq dying cells are usually flagged by high mitochondrial fraction / low complexity instead. Consider whether this state should be scored at all or read only as pathway competence.

memory.description: Antigen-experienced memory compartment. Spans the subsets named in the 2025 consensus: TCM (SELL/CCR7 high), TEM (SELL/CCR7 low), TEMRA (KLRG1, CX3CR1, FCGR3A), TRM (ITGAE/CD103, CD69, ITGA1/CD49a, and loss of S1PR1/KLF2), TPM and TSCM (FAS/CD95, CD28, IL7R with retained TCF7/LEF1). Shares SELL/CCR7/TCF7 with naive-like; the discriminators are IL7R/CD27 positivity plus the residency and terminal-differentiation markers.

curation_notes: Housekeeping sweep 2026-08-10: removed PTPRC (CD45) - pan-leukocyte and among the highest-ranked transcripts in every T cell; RNA cannot see the informative CD45RA/RO isoform split, which lives in the ADT file.

Review 2026-08-10: S1PR1 and KLF2 are kept for the circulating TCM/TEM subsets but are LOSS markers for TRM (composite-state compromise), and both are highest in naive cells, so they do not discriminate memory from naive - that call rests on IL7R/CD27/CD28/FAS and the ADT CD45RA/RO axis.

virtual-memory.description: Virtual memory (TVM): naive T cells that proliferated WITHOUT cognate antigen recognition, giving partial differentiation on a naive backbone. Consensus TVM lineage markers are CD44-hi CD122-hi CD49d-LOW with high EOMES (Eomes binds the IL2RB/CD122 promoter). CD49d is deliberately NOT scored: it is a LOW marker and UCell is additive on presence. CD95 sits in additional, not core - it is shared with TSCM and is not TVM-defining. TVM is described as a CD8 population; treat calls on CD4 cells as unsupported. ITGA4 (CD49d) is excluded for the same reason.

references.title: Roles of Virtual Memory T Cells in Diseases

curation_notes: Review 2026-08-10, no removals: KLRB1 (CD161) also marks MAIT cells, which will score here - corroborate TVM calls against MAIT/TCR annotation where available. The CD44hi/CD122hi/CD49d-lo/EOMES definition is mouse-derived; human TVM are additionally described as KIR+/NKG2A+ EOMES+ - treat human calls as provisional.

curation_notes: Removed ICAM1, VCAM1: VCAM1 and ICAM1 are the endothelial/APC ligands for these integrins, not molecules the T cell itself expresses at informative levels

Review 2026-08-10: removed ITGA8 (kidney/neural integrin, essentially absent from T cells) and ITGAM (CD11b, myeloid-lineage - in T cell data it mostly scores monocyte doublets/contamination). FLAG for expert: ITGA9 and ITGAV have thin T cell evidence; ITGB7 (gut-homing a4b7) and ITGAE (CD103, TRM) make this state overlap the residency half of memory by construction.

references.title: CD57 defines a functionally distinct population of mature NK cells / senescent T cells
references.authors: Multiple sources; CD57 (B3GAT1) is the canonical human T cell senescence surface marker
references.note: B3GAT1 (CD57) added: loss of proliferative capacity with high cytotoxic potential; pairs with KLRG1 and loss of CD28.

curation_notes: Removed ATM, IFNA1, IFNA2, IFNAR1, IFNAR2, MAP3K5, MAPK14, MAPK8, MAPK9, TAB1, TERF2, TSC2: IFNA1/IFNA2 are produced by plasmacytoid dendritic cells, not T cells; the MAPK/TSC kinase cascade genes are ubiquitous signalling components rather than senescence markers
Added IL6, CXCL8, IL1B, SERPINE1: canonical SASP (senescence-associated secretory phenotype) components

Inversion/constitutive sweep 2026-08-10: removed TP53 - regulated by protein stabilisation, not transcription; its mRNA is constitutive and does not mark senescent cells. CD28 checked per protocol: correctly ABSENT (senescent T cells are CD28-null; scoring CD28 would invert). FLAG for expert: IL6/CXCL8/IL1B are canonical SASP but predominantly myeloid transcripts - in T cell data they may score monocyte doublets; KLRK1 (NKG2D) is pan-CD8/NK rather than senescence-specific.

curation_notes: Review 2026-08-10 (resolves the open question): removed PDCD1, HAVCR2, LAG3 from additional. Activated tumour-infiltrating Tregs can express them, but they are the exhaustion CORE module - carrying them in both states makes which.max arbitrary between regulating and exhaustion for checkpoint-high cells. Treg identity is carried by FOXP3/IL2RA/IKZF2/CTLA4 plus the effector-Treg axis (ICOS, TNFRSF18/4, CCR4, LRRC32, IKZF4). TIGIT, ENTPD1, LAYN, CD101, BATF, IRF4, PRDM1 remain shared with exhaustion - acceptable overlap, but treat FOXP3-negative cells labelled regulating with suspicion. FLAG for expert: TGFB1 and IL10RA are broadly expressed across T cells and are weak discriminators.

references.authors: Pipeline maintenance
references.note: Pruned non-cell-cycle genes carried in from a broader 'regulation of proliferation' style list: ABL1, AGER, BAX, CCL5, CD24, CD40LG, CD86, EBI3, IGF1, IGFBP2, IL18, IL2, IL23A, IL4, PTPRC, RIPK2, SLAMF1, STAT5B, SYK, TNFRSF4, TNFSF4, TNFSF9. Symbol corrections: CCNA1 -> CCNA2 (CCNA1 is germline/AML-restricted; the cyclin A of somatic cycling cells is CCNA2) and CCND1 -> CCND2/CCND3 (lymphocytes cycle on cyclin D2/D3; CCND1 is scarcely expressed in T cells). Added CDK6, the dominant D-type cyclin kinase in lymphocytes.
